# Native run

A fresh synthetic Developer scratch subscriber was created for this capture. An existing synthetic provider package, with provider source API 62.0, was installed. The parent directory's qualified and unqualified test classes were submitted as check-only deployments with source and request APIs 62.0 and 67.0. The test methods were not executed. The qualified class compiled and the unqualified class produced the two recorded diagnostics at both API versions.

The scratch subscriber was deleted after capture; deletion was verified. These rows recapture the parent directory's deployment observations without changing them.
